title: Platform message envelope
description: The wrapper every Kafka message carries, on every topic. This is the platform contract: payload schemas embed it by reference and may not override it. Bump schema_version when a field here changes shape.

event_id.description: Unique per emission: sha256(idempotency_key|run_id|try_number). A consumer that has seen this id drops the message.

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic per logical unit of work: sha256(schema_version|event_type|dataset|run_slot|key). A consumer upserts on this key, so a re-run of the same slot replaces rather than duplicates.

run_slot.description: Start of the run's schedule interval, UTC, second precision.

run_id.description: Airflow dag_run.run_id, or a caller-supplied id outside Airflow.

key.description: The row's primary-key value for row events; null for run events.

producer.description: The SASL principal that wrote the message.

signature.description: Compact JWS from the IdP over sha256 of the canonical payload. Required for run.verdict; absent on row events.
